engineering_constraints.description: Rice husk silica extraction: combustion at 500-700°C or acid leaching followed by calcination

narrative.text: Rice husks contain 15-20% silica by weight, making them an abundant source of biosilica. The silica exists in amorphous form and can be extracted via simple combustion, creating high-surface-area adsorbent material.

design_translation.idea: Extract silica from rice husk agricultural waste via combustion or acid treatment, use as adsorbent for heavy metals and organic pollutants
